answer 1. The cellar of Fort Chalkmoth holds something that moans, and the order feeds it Hist sap from Jal-Veesa tree-minder jars, in a fort with no Hist. The gaoler turned me away; Never-Writes-Twice keeps the key. The quest is complete. 2. Go back to the order hunt: travel to Bell Station by boat from Lilmoth and ask the divers which drowned tower is cut deeper. 3. Go to Bell Station; or later find the cellar key from Never-Writes-Twice, or question her. 4. I do not know who or what is behind the cellar door, why the order keeps it secret, or why Never-Writes-Twice called it nothing. I could ask her or find the key.

answer Notes: I am Toh-Wo of the Toh-Reel-Ka. At Fort Chalkmoth I took the yard trapdoor into the cellar guardroom unseen. The wall captain Sakeeus-Wan would have opened the keep for killing three Sarpa raiders (100 gold), but I skipped that. The quartermaster store holds jars of Hist sap tied with the Jal-Veesa tree-minder knot, though the fort has no Hist. The gaoler Tsleel-Vaku guards the locked inner cellar door and refused persuasion and illusion; he has no key, and Never-Writes-Twice keeps it. Something moans behind the door. I do not know who or what is down there or why the order feeds it sap. I carry 2 lockpicks, Unbound-Note, Voh-Vastei-Armour, Eye-Setting, Keystone, Grave-Stake, 3 Paralysis-Poison, Bronze-Disc, Parchment-Map, Rapier, 1050 gold.
